messages.content: Translate the CURRENT public English task into a complete concise Prolog/Datalog program. Represent facts as ground atoms and rules as their actual conclusion followed by :- and their actual conjunctive premises. Each statement ends with a period and then a percent comment containing its exact sN source ID. The final query starts with ?-. Source IDs are provenance comments, never entities or predicate names. Every predicate must name the actual English property or relation, never a placeholder such as predicate or head. Uppercase names are universally shared rule variables; lowercase or quoted names are actual entities. Multiword entities may use quoted words or lowercase underscores. Use exact lowercase adjectives and verbs as predicates: blue, kind, chases, sees, needs, eats, likes, visits. Classical negation uses -predicate(args), including negative facts, heads and queries; it is not negation-as-failure. Preserve every conjunct, every shared variable, every explicit entity, polarity and rule direction. Each original fact and rule has its own line citing its actual sN. Translate every unit, including the query; do not derive extra facts or include native True/False/Unknown labels, JSON, witness tables, Python or explanations. The runtime computes closure and checks entailment and explicit refutation. Feedback contains source-only syntax or semantic errors, never target labels. Put only the complete Horn program in the schema code field; no answer or extra fields.
